Definition: from G2095 and G3529; victorious; Eunice, a Jewess:--Eunice.
BiblicalUsage: Eunice is a Jewish woman whose name means victorious, and she is Timothy's mother. In 2 Timothy 1:5, the text says "and thy mother Eunice." The life behind the name is told on the Eunice People profile.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe Euníkē matters because God knows His people by name, and Euníkē is one of them. That is why I want the name, and the person behind it, kept straight.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
